Jatin Shukla
         Noida, Uttar Pradesh — +91-9116237146 — shukla.jeetu2550@gmail.com — LinkedIn — GitHub — Portfolio
Professional Summary
Senior AI/ML Engineer with around 3 years of total experience building production-grade AI agents, RAG systems, machine
learning models, and full-stack AI applications.  Strong expertise in Python, SQL, FastAPI, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LangChain,
semantic retrieval, prompt engineering, vector search, and cloud deployment. Proven ability to translate business problems into
scalable AI solutions, improve model quality and latency, and deliver measurable impact through user-facing AI products and
intelligent automation.
Technical Skills
Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript, C++, C#
AI / ML: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Regression, Classification, Clustering, Feature Engineering,
Model Evaluation, EDA, Experimentation
GenAI / Agents: AI Agents, LLM Applications, RAG, Prompt Engineering, LangChain, Semantic Search, Context Grounding,
Information Retrieval, Agentic Workflows
Data / Retrieval: FAISS, Vector Search, BM25, Cross-Encoder Reranking, Document Parsing, Unstructured Data Processing, TF-
IDF, Cosine Similarity, Sentence Transformers, Resume & JD Parsing
Frameworks / Deployment: FastAPI, Flask, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs, Docker, Azure, CI/CD, Vercel, Render, Joblib,
Git, GitHub
Experience
Senior Engineer – AI/ML                                                          Mar 2026 – Present
Havells India Ltd., Noida
 • Built AI agents for applicant shortlisting for HR workflows, automating resume screening, JD matching, and ranking logic to
   reduce manual review effort by 40%+ and accelerate shortlist turnaround.
 • Developed agentic ideation, research, and prototyping workflows for internal use, enabling structured 10-step reasoning
   pipelines for faster concept exploration and improving early-stage solution turnaround by 30%.
 • Enhanced internal AI products with retrieval, prompt orchestration, scoring logic, and user-facing workflows, improving usability
  and consistency for business teams across model-assisted decision tasks.
AI/ML Engineer                                                                          Jan 2025 – Feb 2026
Havells India Ltd., Noida
 • Built and deployed ML models for the fan team to predict air delivery, velocity, and pressure on fan blades, improving engineering
   prediction accuracy by 18–22% and reducing iterative validation effort.
 • Developed ML models for the LED team to estimate heat generation at critical points, supporting thermal-performance analysis
  and reducing design evaluation turnaround by 35%.
 • Engineered a production inference pipeline for a Tri-Branch PointNet regression model, reducing end-to-end latency by 35%
   through optimized preprocessing, feature scaling, and joblib-based deployment.
 • Designed automated data preprocessing, feature engineering, and inference consistency pipelines using Python, PyTorch, Scikit-
   learn, and joblib, improving model reliability across environments.
 • Built UI-driven internal applications for model interaction using Flask, React, and VTK.js, enabling 30+ engineers to use AI
   outputs through business-friendly interfaces and cross-platform packages.
 • Created scalable 3D / point-cloud evaluation workflows handling 10+ design configurations per week, reducing manual
   analysis and dependence on physical prototyping.
Projects
Nexora – AI Study Assistant                                                      Personal Project — Live — GitHub
 • Built Nexora, a full-stack RAG-based AI knowledge assistant using React, Vite, FastAPI, and Supabase to manage app data
  and support grounded Q&A over PDFs and web URLs.
 • Engineered a hybrid retrieval pipeline with FAISS for dense semantic search, BM25 for sparse retrieval, and Cross-Encoder
   reranking, improving relevance over vector-only search.
 • Developed an AI learning workflow with quiz generation, scoring, explanations, weak-topic feedback, and 6 answer modes, turning
   static content into an interactive study system.
HireFit – AI Resume–Job Matcher                                               Personal Project — Live — GitHub
 • Built a full-stack AI/ML and GenAI application using FastAPI, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Python, and Gemini API for
  resume-JD matching, ATS scoring, semantic comparison, and recruiter-facing recommendations.
 • Designed structured evaluation pipelines combining TF-IDF, cosine similarity, evidence validation, prompt-based reasoning, and
   multi-factor scoring for accurate profile-to-role assessment.
 • Implemented features including keyword coverage analysis, shortlist-risk analysis, safer resume rewrites, multi-JD comparison,
  and export-ready outputs for end users.
AgentFlow – Multi-Agent AI Platform                                           Personal Project — Live — GitHub
 • Built a full-stack multi-agent AI orchestration platform using FastAPI, LangGraph, Groq, React, and SQLite, routing tasks
   across 4 specialist agents for research, coding, writing, and analysis.
 • Designed a 6-stage controlled AI workflow with memory retrieval, supervisor planning, backend tools, reviewer scoring, and
   human-in-the-loop approval to improve reliability.
 • Implemented workspace-isolated memory, run history, and trace persistence capturing agent decisions, tool usage, review scores,
  human actions, and final outputs.
IoT-Enabled Digital Twin for Post-Harvest Loss Minimization                              Research Project — Link
 • Built an Azure-based AI + IoT system using Raspberry Pi and sensors for predictive analytics, real-time monitoring, and decision
   support, reducing potential post-harvest losses by 15–20%.
Education
National Institute of Technology, Hamirpur                                                          2023 – 2025
M.Tech, Computer Science and Engineering                                                  CGPA: 9.15/10
Institute of Engineering and Technology, Lucknow                                                    2018 – 2022
B.Tech, Chemical Engineering                                                            CGPA: 7.8/10
